summary.zh: 生成“X 对比 Y”与替代品页，附公平的对比矩阵
summary.en: Build a fair, sourced X vs Y or alternative page with a matrix

description.zh: 为“某产品对比某产品”或“某产品的替代方案”这类页面搭结构：先建对比矩阵，再定版式，最后写有来源支撑的公平论述。适合做竞品对比页、替代品合集或换用说服页之前使用。矩阵生成脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Builds X vs Y and alternative-to pages: a comparison matrix first, then a layout, then fair claims with sources. Use it before a competitor comparison, an alternatives roundup or a switching page. The matrix builder needs local Python.
